_comment: The ALLOWED-TYPES GRAMMAR for the compliance-readiness context, in the exact ProjectTypeTreeView shape (Part 2). This is what getProjectTypeTree(orgId | projectId) returns; listAllowedProjectTypes(id) is derived from a node's children. The tree is PATH-DEPENDENT (a type's allowed children depend on its parent). isDefault marks the position default the server picks when projectTypeId is omitted on create. Used to drive the mock's '+ Add sub-project' affordance and the governance/allowed-types view.
_grammar: program -> workspace(framework) -> aperture(control family) -> thread(practice/control effort). 'project' is an alternate root for free-form efforts (open-world fallback).
_note: ASSUMPTION (flagged in BRIEF §7): compliance levels (framework / control-family / practice) are carried by the generic shipped tiers via naming + the projectType chip, NOT minted as new project types. Alternative = register compliance-domain project types; deferred design question.
